milestones.title: Wipe-clean
milestones.body: Something came back on you, and it did not stick. A colleague says you are very easy to work with, and does not mean it kindly. You have earned a Milestone: Wipe-clean.

milestones.title: Slippery as an eel
milestones.body: Another one slid off. People have started to check the minutes after meetings you were in, to see what you said, and you never said anything. You have earned a Milestone: Slippery as an eel.

milestones.title: Non-stick, dishwasher safe
milestones.body: Nothing that comes back on you has ever stayed. Somebody in Finance has started a sweepstake on it. You have earned a Milestone: Non-stick, dishwasher safe.
